questions.q: In 'The Cat and the Old Rat', what was the Cat's first trick?
choices: He hung from a shelf as if he were dead
He hid inside a shoe by the door
He pretended to sleep by the mouse hole
He rolled in mud so no one could see him
questions.evidence: he climbed up on a shelf and hung from it, head downward, as if he were dead

questions.q: In 'The Cat and the Old Rat', what did the Cat cover himself with for his second trick?
choices: Flour
Leaves
Mud
Snow

questions.q: In 'The Cat and the Old Rat', why was the old Rat not fooled?
choices: He had much experience with Cats and traps
He could smell the cheese the Cat was eating
He saw the Cat's tail twitch under the flour
Another young Mouse ran up and warned him
questions.evidence: who had had much experience with Cats and traps

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Cat and the Old Rat'?
choices: The wise are not tricked a second time
Cats are always hungry for rats and mice
Never go near a heap of white flour
Old rats are braver than young mice
questions.evidence: The wise do not let themselves be tricked a second time.

questions.q: In 'The Fox and the Crow', how did the Fox get the cheese?
choices: He flattered the Crow so she opened her beak
He climbed the tree and grabbed it from her
He traded her a nice piece of meat for the cheese
He scared her with a loud sudden bark
questions.evidence: she opened her beak wide to utter her loudest caw

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Fox and the Crow'?
choices: The flatterer lives at the expense of those who listen
Crows have lovely voices and should sing more often
Always share your breakfast with a hungry friend
Foxes do not really like cheese as much as crows do
questions.evidence: The flatterer lives at the expense of those who will listen to him.

questions.q: In 'The Ass and Its Shadow', why did the Traveler and the Driver quarrel?
choices: They both wanted to rest in the Ass's shadow
They both wanted to ride the Ass at once
They got lost on the hot and sandy road
The Traveler would not pay for the Ass
questions.evidence: he had hired the Ass and not the shadow it cast

questions.q: In 'The Ass and Its Shadow', what happened while the two men were fighting?
choices: The Ass ran away
The Sun went down
A storm blew in
The Ass lay down
questions.evidence: the Ass took to its heels
